## PitStopReadyCheck_004a6200 — Pit stop readiness evaluation

**Summary:** Determines if vehicle is ready for pit stop by checking wheel speed, race session state, and tire compound decision. Sets pit stop timer and triggers pit lane entry logic. Part of pit state machine.

**Frame-path:** ON_FRAME_PATH  
**Call frequency:** per-frame tick

**Called by:** PitStateUpdateMachine (004a6e50)

**Struct fields accessed:**

| Base | Offset | R/W | Init (literal → value) | Purpose |
|------|--------|-----|------------------------|---------|
| obj | 0x32C8 | R | — | Pit state flag (1 = in pit stop mode) |
| obj | 0x34F8 | R | — | Wheel spin/speed X — used to detect if moving too fast for pit stop |
| obj | 0x34FC | R | — | Wheel spin/speed Y |
| obj | 0x3500 | R | — | Wheel spin/speed Z |
| this | 0x0 | R | — | Pointer to obj struct (first field) |
| this | 0x8 | R | — | Secondary object pointer for 3D transform |
| this | 0x190 | RW | 0 | Pit stop ready flag (1 = ready, 0 = not ready) |
| this | 0x1A0 | RW | — | Pit stop timer target (set from parameter a2) |
| this | 0x1A4 | RW | — | Pit stop timer current (PitStopOperationTimer result + target) |
| this | 0x1AC | RW | 1 | Qualifying DSQ check flag (0 = already checked for DSQ) |

**Written-by note (persistence):**
- this 0x190: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist
- this 0x1A0: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist
- this 0x1A4: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist
- this 0x1AC: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist

**Globals referenced:**

| Address | Name | R/W | Role |
|---------|------|-----|------|
| 005acb50 | flt_5ACB50 | R | Flt_AiCornerSpeedGain_CB50 [DERIVED] (also: ` — alternate velocity threshold) |
| 005ea3ec | byte_5EA3EC | R | LeftHandPitFlag [DERIVED] |

| 007c54e8 | dword_7C54E8 | R | PlayerVehiclePtr [FACT] |
| 007ce048 | dword_7CE048 | R | RaceSessionState [DERIVED] (also: ` (dword_7CE048) |
| 007ce814 | dword_7CE814 | R | QualifyingDSQEnabled [DERIVED] |

**Functions called:**

| Address | Name | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|
| 0040d3c0 | ShortComputation_d3c0 | Send race event/session command (pit entry or other) |
| 0042a3d0 | PitStopDecisionTireCompound | Determine tire compound decision for pit stop |
| 004a3320 | sub_4A3320 | Process 3D transform for pit stop positioning |
| 004a6340 | PitStopOperationTimer | Calculate pit stop operation timer value |
| 004ef930 | RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate | Update race start countdown state (parameter 0 = clear) |
| 004efb20 | F_3DTransformWithMatrixMultiplication | Transform position for pit stop alignment check |
| 004f1b50 | CameraModeSetter | Set camera mode to race camera (mode 1) |

**Guard conditions (deterministic — field vs literal):**

| Base | Offset | Test | Value | Field / meaning |
|------|--------|------|-------|-----------------|
| obj | 0x32C8 | == | 1 | Pit state flag (1 = in pit stop mode) |

**Guard interpretation:** When obj+0x32C8 == 1 (vehicle in pit stop mode), PASSES — enters pit stop timer and tire compound decision logic. When obj+0x32C8 != 1 (not in pit stop mode), BLOCKED — skips pit stop timer/countdown logic.
